name: ADX-gated breakout continuation — faster 1h cadence (fee-hurdle test)
rationale: MECHANISM: same conditional-breakout economics as the 4h ADX-gated variant (breakouts only pay in an established directional regime; ADX filters trend from the fee-churning chop where breaks fail) but on a 1h bar for a higher-frequency expression of the hypothesis. The 1h cadence catches more intraday continuation moves at the cost of a lower per-trade edge, so this variant directly stresses whether the ADX-gated breakout survives the taker-fee hurdle at speed. Entry: range_position near the ceiling AND adx above a fitted floor. DISCONFIRMER: kill if the adx gate adds no net lift vs the ungated 1h breakout (curve-fit), OR if the faster cadence pushes net-of-fee below the ~3x round-trip cost survival threshold — that would show the edge only exists at slow bars where fees are diluted, not as a genuine 1h effect.
catalyst: range-ceiling breakout inside a confirmed trend, faster cadence
